body.name: Two-score Gaussian maximum benchmark
body.construction: For \(z=(z_1,z_2)^{\top}\in\mathbb R^2\), set \(K_{\max,\alpha,\Delta}(z)=\operatorname{conv}(\{t\in\{0\}:|z_1|\le k_{\alpha}\}\cup\{t\in\{\Delta\}:|z_2|\le k_{\alpha}\})\), where \(k_{\alpha}\) is determined by \((2\Phi(k_{\alpha})-1)^2=1-\alpha\).
